column4: toolchain-gated: cleat#1980 item 1's PYTHON half deploys a real component built with componentize-py, which THIS job does not install. Python is tier 1, and its toolchain is provisioned by the tier-1 Gate's rest shard (scripts/tier-gate.sh refuses to run at all without componentize-py and wasm-tools) and by e2e-cross-language.yml -- not by test-go/commands. The gate is legitimate rather than convenient: the test calls t.Fatalf, not t.Skip, when CLEAT_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAINS names python, so a job that PROMISES the toolchain cannot silently skip it. ONE SKIP, TWO SITES: the function has two t.Skip call sites (the toolchain gate and the standard -short guard), which is why skip-baseline.txt records 2, but the toolchain one is checked first and the -short one is unreachable here -- so the count is 1. Measured by name: go test ./cmd/cleatctl/ -run '^TestAPythonFixtureWorkflowDeploysWithASchema$' -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly 1 (with CLEAT_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAINS unset). Companion: skip-ledger.d/a-real-python-fixture-validates-start-input.tsv charges the same toolchain for cleat#1981's Python fixture.
